Write Slurm scripts that split a study across a job array

Source: R/slurm.R
write_slurm_array.Rd

Writes run.sbatch, an array job in which each task runs script with its shard of the designs, and collect.sbatch, which runs after every task succeeds and assembles the results from the shared cache. The study script should build its control with control_sim(cache = "<shared dir>", shard = sim_shard()) and save the results (e.g. with saveRDS()) when it is not a shard (is.null(sim_shard())).

Usage

write_slurm_array(
  script,
  dir,
  tasks,
  cluster = c("ceres", "atlas", "other"),
  account = NULL,
  time = "04:00:00",
  memory = "4G",
  cpus = 1,
  partition = NULL,
  modules = "r",
  container = NULL,
  max_concurrent = NULL
)

Arguments

script

Path of the R script to run (copied into dir).

dir

Output directory.

tasks

Number of array tasks.

cluster

"ceres", "atlas" or "other".

account

Slurm account (required on Atlas).

time

Walltime per task, e.g. "04:00:00".

memory

Memory per task, e.g. "8G".

cpus

CPUs per task (use with control_sim(parallel = TRUE)).

partition

Override the profile's partition.

modules

Environment modules to load, e.g. "r"; empty when using a container.

container

Optional Apptainer image with R and tidyagsim; tasks then run apptainer exec <image> Rscript.

max_concurrent

Limit on simultaneously running tasks.

Value

The paths written, invisibly.

Details

Profiles exist for SCINet Ceres and Atlas; other clusters work by passing partition and account directly. Submit with sbatch run.sbatch; it submits the collection step itself.

Examples

script <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
writeLines("library(tidyagsim)", script)
write_slurm_array(script, tempfile("slurm"), tasks = 20, cluster = "ceres")
